integrity: Uniform proof is mathematical and not contingent on finite tests. Finite verifier confirms n=5..9. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for circular ladders n>=5 and ordinary 3-cut complexes only. Earlier arXiv:2512.04486, Conjecture 4.6(ii), already proposed the homology formula without a proof. The new result proves it and derives a sphere-wedge homotopy type. Subsequent unindexed results remain a literature risk.
title: Sphere-wedge topology of three-cut complexes of circular ladders
